tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Not later than 3 years after March 30, 2009, the Secretary shall develop a comprehensive management plan for the long-term protection and management of the Conservation Area.

children.text: describe the appropriate uses and management of the Conservation Area;
be developed with extensive public input;
take into consideration any information developed in studies of the land within the Conservation Area; and
include a comprehensive travel management plan.
